LESSON: SHAPES

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Strand: Geometry
Topic 3.2: Shapes

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Shapes. Read, look at the pictures, practise, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: LOOK AND LEARN

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-2/mathematics/page-138.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 2 — page 138]]

From your pupil's book (page 138)

GEOMETRY SHAPES Week 11 Lesson 4 Ovals Activity Name the shape

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-2/mathematics/page-185.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 2 — page 185]]

From your pupil's book (page 185)

GEOMETRY SHAPES Week 8 Lesson 4 Squares Activity Name the shape

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-2/mathematics/page-074.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 2 — page 74]]

From your pupil's book (page 74)

GEOMETRY SHAPES Week 11 Lesson 5 Triangles, Circles and Rectangles

Triangles are A, B, and D Circles are E, G, H and I Rectangles are C, F and J

SECTION 3: TRY THIS

1. Look again at the examples or pictures above.
2. Tell a parent or friend what Shapes means, using your own words.
3. Copy one example into your exercise book and change it to fit your school or home.
4. Underline three new words and find out what they mean.

SECTION 4: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Shapes.
2. Complete any “Work to do” items shown in the pupil book pages above.
3. Create three of your own practice questions on this topic.
4. Answer the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after finishing.

SECTION 5: REMEMBER

1. Topic: Shapes
2. Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
3. Learning materials: Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 2
4. Revise with the quiz now.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
